changelog:
- Major rewrite: refocused from local shell-script upscaling to a model-routed, async workflow leveraging video-to-video super-resolution APIs.
- Removed installation and script usage details; now guides users to collect video, resolution, and quality info and select among three specialized upscaler models (Topaz, ByteDance, Bria).
- Explains model-specific parameters, how to check model schemas, async job polling, and output quality standards.
- Clarifies this skill is for video (not still images) and that no chaining or prompt-based steering is supported.
- All code/scripts and install instructions removed; documentation is now only for system-level skill API usage.
summary: Increase a video's resolution and restore lost detail, up to 4K. Use when the user says "upscale this video", "make this clip higher-res / sharper", "enhance...
